entities.name: Axel Kárason

entities.summary: Axel Kárason is an Icelandic former basketball player and a former member of the Icelandic national team, where he participated at the EuroBasket 2015. He won the Icelandic championship in 2023 and the Icelandic Cup in 2018 with Tindastóll.
